The portrait of the two women was taken at the Carlisle Journeys event on Oct. 6, 2018, which marked the centennial of the closing of the Carlisle Indian Industrial School in Pennsylvania. items.title: ’This fight is about protecting the sacred’
items.summary: Pueblo of Santa Ana Chairman Joey Sanchez speaks on Nov. 9 in front of the U.S. Capitol. He travelled to Washington, D.C. to urge Congress to reject a bill that would weaken provisions of the National Historic Preservation Act that tribes use to protect sacred sites. “Congress is about to trade them for speed, and tribes and the public will pay for it,” he said.
